policy_title: Strengthen Office for Environmental Protection and Funding for Agencies
stated: Strengthen the Office for Environmental Protection and provide more funding to the Environment Agency and Natural England to help protect our environment and enforce environmental laws.

source.quote: Strengthen the Office for Environmental Protection and provide more funding to the Environment Agency and Natural England to help protect our environment and enforce environmental laws.

bearing_set.reason: Strengthening the OEP and funding the Environment Agency and Natural England directly affects enforcement of environmental law, water quality regulation, nature protection, and emissions oversight — all core O6 indicators.

membership_note: Policy is single-target: all three bodies (OEP, EA, Natural England) operate squarely within O6's indicators (air/water quality, biodiversity, emissions pathway, enforcement). Fiscal cost to public finances (O12) is plausible but the policy specifies no quantum and agency budgets are modest relative to the debt path — mechanism is too diffuse to clear the non-negligible bar. No other fundamental has a concrete, mechanistically-justified spillover.
